# Feature: Item 3D upload, preview, Meshy Image-to-3D

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-06 — issue #141 -->

## Intent

Workbench optional `model3d` asset: validated GLB upload or explicit Meshy Image-to-3D from a persisted thumbnail. 3D is display-only; Library/Inventory keep loading thumbnails only. Secrets and provider calls stay server-side (fail-closed without `MESHY_API_KEY`).

## Preconditions

- Signed-in user can edit a personal or world ItemDefinition (#136).
- Thumbnail pipeline (#140) available; Meshy Image-to-3D requires configured `MESHY_API_KEY` and a persisted thumbnail for generate-from-image.
- `three` already installed; existing avatar 3D runtime is a pattern only.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Workbench `3D` section supports optional validated GLB upload (≤50 MB) and explicit Meshy Image-to-3D from persisted thumbnail with reload-stable job status and lazy 3D preview.
- [ ] 3D results materialize into owner-/world-scoped SagaDrive storage; ItemDefinition binds only via logical `model3d` asset key / manifest — never durable provider URLs.
- [ ] Cardinality: exactly one Image-to-3D job per confirmed Generate/Retry click (submit lock + disabled while active).
- [ ] Secrets, MIME/magic/GLB structure validation, remote download host/size/timeout limits, and rate/cost guards are server-side; missing Meshy key → upload-only / `not-configured`.
- [ ] Replace/Remove/WebGL failure keep prior valid model or empty state; Library/Inventory never mount 3D as thumbnail substitute.
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict).

## Edge Cases

- [ ] No thumbnail → `Aus Bild generieren` disabled with explanation; GLB upload still allowed.
- [ ] Thumbnail replaced mid-job → job stays bound to input snapshot/task; must not claim result came from new image.
- [ ] Corrupt/oversized GLB → no active asset switch; prior model kept.
- [ ] WebGL/preview fails → download/item still valid; 2D fallback copy visible.
- [ ] Multiple library cards never initialize 3D renderers.

## Regression

- [ ] Thumbnail upload/generate (#140) still works.
- [ ] Item mechanics / inventory rules unchanged by presence of `model3d`.
- [ ] Routing/workbench dirty blocker unchanged.

## Assumptions

- V1 formats: GLB only; Meshy uses fixed server-side Image-to-3D defaults (no expert panel).
- Prefer Meshy thumbnail `input_task_id` when origin=meshy; else backend loads owner-scoped image bytes for provider input (no public private-storage URLs).
- Extend `useItemAssets` rather than inventing a separate Meshy-only hook.

## Implementation Notes

- Separate Edge Function `item-model3d` (mirrors #140 `item-thumbnail`); private bucket `item-models` (50 MB, `model/gltf-binary`); tables `item_model3d_assets` / `item_model3d_jobs` / `item_model3d_rate_limits` via migration `018`.
- Jobs snapshot `input_thumbnail_asset_id` + `input_provider_task_id`; generate prefers Meshy thumbnail `provider_task_id` as `input_task_id`, else owner-scoped image bytes as data URI.
- Domain key `model3d:{uuid}`; fork strips `model3d`; Library/Inventory unchanged (thumbnail only).
- Workbench: GLB upload, Image-to-3D (disabled without thumbnail), remove/retry, lazy Three preview with reduced-motion-aware spin; fail-closed Meshy copy when key missing.
- Client invokes only `item-model3d`; `MESHY_API_KEY` server-only. Offline Deno tests + `scripts/item-model3d-assets-check.mjs` in test-gate.
